_doc: Print Labels (Print Asset) mobile screen test data. Component: Frontend/src/pages/PrintAsset/index.tsx → Frontend/src/components/PrintAsset/index.tsx. Route: /MobileViewScreen/print-asset. Two tabs (Containers / Locations). Containers tab uses GET /containers and filters client-side by code/type/location.path. Locations tab uses GET /locations/dashboard-summary with server-side search and infinite scroll. Tap a card → opens QrCodeDialog. Print button inside the dialog opens window.open then calls printWindow.print().

placeholders.containersSearch: Search by code, type, or location

qrDialog._doc: QrCodeDialog uses window.open('', '_blank') then printWindow.print() — Cypress can't follow the new window. The wmsHelpers cy.iaStubWindowOpen helper records calls so tests can assert print was triggered.
